content: Vedant followed up on a term life insurance plan discussed in an earlier call. He asked for a coverage recommendation given his family size (wife and two children). Agent Anjali advised 5-7 times annual income and asked for his income, which Vedant stated as 15 lakhs. Vedant also inquired about the difference between term life and whole life insurance.

topics: Difference between term and whole life insurance
action_items: Anjali to explain the difference between term and whole life insurance
Anjali to recommend specific coverage based on 15 lakhs income
